# Equity index (`equity-index` v1)

Index level with its largest constituents.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `EQX` · **Identifiers:** `EQX-…` in `indexId`

Open one with `EQX <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: equity-index
version: 1
description: Index level with its largest constituents.
match: { kind: equity-index, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Equity index, id: $.indexId }
strip:
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Level, bind: $.level, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: "1D", bind: $.change1d, fmt: pct2, tone: sign }
  - { label: Constituents, bind: $.constituentCount }
  - { label: Currency, bind: $.currency }
panels:
  - id: constituents
    kind: table
    title: Top constituents
    key: F2
    rows: $.constituents
    columns:
      - { label: Equity, bind: "@.equity" }
      - { label: Weight, bind: "@.weight", fmt: pct2 }
  - id: history
    kind: line
    title: "Level, last 30 days"
    area: right
    rows: $.history
    x: date
    y: close
    fmt: price2
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.equityVolSurface, 'equity-vol-surface')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
